listing.name: Worms World Party — WormsWorldPartyRecomp (NVDEMU)
listing.summary: Experimental project. This native WWP project includes generic mods that are mostly experimental and disabled by default. The README does not establish full-game or platform completion. Updater signature procedures do not establish Portcove executable trust. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA SLUS01448; own CUE/disc, bundled OpenBIOS.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the developer setup’s psxrecomp_cli.py generate command with your own SLUS01448 CUE, then build psx-runtime with CMake and Ninja. The README’s generatedC and stamp requirement for release CI on the current main branch does not require you to obtain pregenerated files when regenerating locally. The described release archives and OpenBIOS have not been inspected or approved as managed packages.

warnings: This native WWP project includes generic mods that are mostly experimental and disabled by default. The README does not establish full-game or platform completion. Updater signature procedures do not establish Portcove executable trust.
